label_ru: The Риэлтор — изобретение с нуля, light/bright, мемы, Wordstat-стикеры, anti-repeat 14д
invention_rule: Cover agent INVENTS every cover from scratch to surprise. No inventory lock. No recurring default props (keys, hologram, desk, balcony, documents-only office). Variety is the product.

meme_system.host_human_rule: ONLY Святослав (face-studio-2026-06-23.jpg) may be LARGE / hero of any frame — COVER ONLY. No second human hero anywhere.

meme_system.cats: meme-cat sticker cutouts — small accent (≤12–15% frame); often enough across weekly posts; not every frame

per_article_8_set.people_source: cover host ONLY counts as the person in the 8-set; inline people-memes are tiny stickers on 1–2 panels max, never a second hero
per_article_8_set.cats_frequency: at least one cat motif per article OR ensure weekly cadence has cats
forbidden: stock/generated handsome man as co-host on inline
invented photogenic stranger called a meme
meme person in left portrait / talking-head / presenter slot on inline
meme person >15% of inline frame area

identity_lock.face: face-studio-2026-06-23.jpg only for FACE i2i; match bone structure, hairline, eye shape, stubble, 28yo
